hook: Getting Older Is Inevitable. Getting Weaker Doesn't Have to Be.
caption:
Getting Older Is Inevitable. Getting Weaker Doesn't Have to Be.

It's easy to explain those changes with three words:

title: She can’t stop after one piece of cheese at night. Not because she has no discipline. Because she’s been disciplined for every single person around her since 6a
hook: She can’t stop after one piece of cheese at night. Not because she has no discipline. Because she’s been disciplined for every single person around her since 6a
caption:
She can’t stop after one piece of cheese at night. Not because she has no discipline. Because she’s been disciplined for every single person around her since 6am.

She got the kids out the door. She answered every email. She showed up for her clients, her boss, her partner, her mom.

She said yes when she wanted to say no. She stayed calm when she wanted to scream.

By 9pm, there’s nothing left for her. So she stands at the fridge and eats, because food is the only thing all day that was just for her.

That’s not a willpower problem. It’s what happens when everyone gets your discipline

title: I used to have a folder full of certificates and still felt like I wasn’t allowed to start.
hook: I used to have a folder full of certificates and still felt like I wasn’t allowed to start.
caption:
I used to have a folder full of certificates and still felt like I wasn’t allowed to start.

Every time I got close, there was one more course. One more training. One more thing I “needed” before I could begin.
It felt so productive, but it felt responsible.
Here’s what I finally saw: as long as I was still learning, I could never fail. Preparing was safe. Starting was where I could be judged.

The belief underneath was “I have to know everything before I begin.”
The truth? I already knew enough to take the next step. I just didn’t trust it yet.

title: When people say they feel stuck, I don’t always think they have no options.
hook: When people say they feel stuck, I don’t always think they have no options.
caption:
When people say they feel stuck, I don’t always think they have no options.

Sometimes, I think they already know what they need to do.

Leave the job.
Have the conversation.
Set the boundary.
Start again.
Say no.
Say yes.
Let go.

The hard part is that every decision comes with a consequence.

You may disappoint someone.
You may lose something familiar.
You may make the wrong choice.
You may have to start from zero.

So instead of deciding, we say we’re stuck.

Because “stuck” feels like something is happening to us.

A decision means accepting that we have a part to play in what happens next
